description: This file is a Perl script that functions as a utility for flashing firmware on a D-Link DSL-502T router using the ADAM2 bootloader. It includes network communication, firmware verification, flash memory manipulation, and device control functionalities.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with the ADAM2 bootloader and device-specific commands.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Send USER command with uppercase requirement.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieve environment variable from the device.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Send reboot command to the device.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.
